projects.title: alas PACS - RIS
projects.description: Developer in alas PACS-RIS project, a Picture Archiving and Communication System for the Popular Ministry Power for Health in Venezuela and PDVSA’s clinics, specifically in alas PACSWeb module. Standing out to implement a set of specialized tools and 2D visualization of medical images in web. Research and implementation of DICOM standard. Modular and extensible application. Used HTML 5, jQuery, KnockoutJS, MVVM pattern and others.
